name: Ciel Sadsmile
source:
She is a nun and serves in the monastery "Bludelilie".
She is also a student of the famous teacher - Virgilia Seiner.
According to the "Longevity" system - Ciel is a mtsyr of the highest rank.

[spoiler]Has two versions of herself: Alpha and Beta (there may be other versions of Ciel).[/spoiler]
